_help: Tools in the leather roll. kind: dig | tap | scan | probe. pattern: single | plus | row3 | square3. damage hits the centre cell, sideDamage the others in the pattern. affects: rock tags the tool works on ([] = every breakable rock). cracks: none | overshoot (cracks a bone if the hit is stronger than the rock left on it) | area (cracks every bone in the 3x3 around the hit). charges: uses per dig (scan/probe only). region: where you get it.

tools.name: Brush
tools.blurb: Slow but totally safe. Sweeps away 1 layer of rock.

tools.name: Chisel
tools.blurb: Knocks off 3 layers. Cracks a bone if there's less than 3 rock left on it.

tools.name: Pickaxe
tools.blurb: Fast! Smashes a cross of rock, but cracks any bone right next to the hit.

tools.name: Tap hammer
tools.blurb: Tap the rock face and listen: hollow = bone here, echo = bone next door, solid = nothing.

tools.name: Scanner
tools.blurb: Pencils in every bone within 2 squares. Only a few charges per dig.

tools.name: Trowel
tools.blurb: Scrapes a row of 3 squares of soft rock. Safe.

tools.name: Spray bottle
tools.blurb: Soaks a cross of soft rock so it washes away. Safe.

tools.name: Probe rod
tools.blurb: Push it down a column: it marks the first bone below.

tools.name: Heat lamp
tools.blurb: Gently melts a 3x3 patch of ice and frozen ground. Safe.

tools.name: Air blower
tools.blurb: Puffs away a 3x3 patch of volcanic ash. Safe.
